lines.text: Moses set aside three cities across the Jordan to the east.
A manslayer who killed his neighbor unintentionally, without prior malice, could flee to one of these cities.
By fleeing to one of these cities, he could save his own home.
Bezer was in the wilderness on the plateau belonging to the Reubenites.
Ramoth was in Gilead belonging to the Gadites, and Golan was in Bashan belonging to the Levites.
